name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-on-off-pipes
title: Super Mario World - ON/OFF Pipes
description:
These are the pipes that are controlled by the ON/OFF switch, in the Super Mario World style.
It indicates that will work only if are in a specific state, and horizontal pipes are included as well.

It's necessary to use the blocks that are included for these specific pipes, which are modified blocks from MarioE's Switch Pack, and ready to be inserted with GPS.

Be sure to give credits to Walmaker, ripped from this sheet!
